checks.foreign: FARA: the bulk FARA files (all registrants, short-form registrants, foreign principals) were searched by exact name on 2026-10-13 by the records collector and re-checked here; the loose name matches in that output are other people, and nothing matches this candidate. 2026 House candidate report lists no foreign assets or income. Disclosures: read the filed PDF from the House Clerk (local copy pulled 2026-10-13). Net worth = sum of asset ranges minus sum of liability ranges as filed; a personal residence is not a reportable asset, so a mortgage on it pushes the range down.

note.t: 2026 candidate report (filed Sept. 15, 2026; covers Jan. 1, 2025–Apr. 15, 2026). No assets above the reporting threshold and no earned income are listed. Liabilities of $95K–$250K: a Shellpoint mortgage ($50K–$100K), a Redstone Federal Credit Union home-equity line, a Wyndham timeshare loan and a Chase credit card ($15K–$50K each). Position: founder of Maslow's Meals, a nonprofit with no current activity. Her home is not a reportable asset, so the negative range understates net worth. No foreign assets or income. In May 2025 she filed a notice that she had not yet crossed the $5,000 threshold; a separate 2025 candidate report (AL-05) was filed the same day as this one.

research_notes: Courts 'news' rests on one news search that surfaced nothing about her. Democracy stays 'news'.
